description: Sole host-invoked entry point for another plugin's own workflow to submit content for Notion or Linear storage or action.

evals.name: Valid cross-plugin submission
evals.prompt: Another plugin's workflow (source_plugin: analysis-kit, source_skill: running-a-full-retrospective) submits: {"content": {"title": "Q3 Retrospective", "summary": "Three-sentence summary.", "body": "Full report content."}, "target_system": "notion", "suggested_mapping": {"notion_database": "Reports", "rationale": "completed retrospective report"}}. Process this submission.
evals.expected_output: Validates the payload (real installed source plugin, complete Report shape with title+summary+body, unambiguous target), builds a preview identical in form to a direct user capture, and states this requires fresh live approval regardless of the calling plugin's own prior approval.

evals.name: Invalid submission — unknown source
evals.prompt: Another plugin's workflow (source_plugin: totally-made-up-plugin, source_skill: some-skill) submits: {"content": {"title": "Test", "body": "Test content"}, "target_system": "notion", "suggested_mapping": {"notion_database": "Reports", "rationale": "test"}}. Process this submission.
evals.expected_output: Rejects this as unknown source (and independently as malformed content, since a Report requires summary too) before ever building a preview, and returns a structured handoff rather than guessing.

evals.name: Ambiguous target — no confident classifier pick
evals.prompt: Another plugin's workflow (source_plugin: analysis-kit, source_skill: running-a-full-retrospective) submits: {"content": {"title": "Retrospective Notes", "summary": "Loose notes, not yet categorized.", "body": "Assorted findings."}, "target_system": "notion", "suggested_mapping": {"notion_database": null, "rationale": "not sure if this belongs in Reports or Notes"}}. Process this submission.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the target as ambiguous (no clear single Notion database/page), never infers or picks one itself. Either returns a structured handoff directly, or asks via AskUserQuestion whether to request independent classification first -- and if it describes a classifier dispatch, attributes it to work-intake-classifier reached through plugins/workmanagement-kit/FOUNDATION_CONTRACTS.md's Codex Bridge-Caller Dispatch procedure (a scoped Bash(bridge_caller.py) call), not a direct Agent()/Skill() call. Never presents a preview with a confirmed target scope for this payload.

evals.name: Frontmatter-description vs. declared-trigger-phrase consistency (Quick Workflow, methodology note below)
evals.prompt: For each phrase in this skill's own '## Testing & Validation' > 'Verify this skill activates on' list, would this skill's frontmatter description plausibly trigger on it?
evals.expected_output: Every declared positive trigger phrase maps to vocabulary actually present in the frontmatter description.

methodology_note_eval_4: This run's with_skill grading was performed directly by the orchestrating fork (a 'Do NOT spawn subagents' hard rule barred the normal Agent-tool dispatch this pipeline's WITH_SKILL_ONLY template calls for) via description-vs-trigger-phrase textual/semantic consistency checking, not a full agentic task simulation. No SKILL.md content changed this session -- this run's purpose was a sanity check that adding scripts/smoke_test.py to each skill didn't coincide with any drift between the skill's own documented trigger claims and its frontmatter, not a search for new behavioral defects.
